metadata.description: ctrlPi plugins: control Raspberry Pi, Pico and ESP32 boards from Claude.

plugins.name: ctrlpi-mcp
plugins.description: Control Raspberry Pi, Pico W and ESP32 GPIO agents on your LAN: read and write pins, pulse relays, read sensors, manage scripts.

plugins.name: pico-bay
plugins.description: Work with Raspberry Pi Pico and ESP32 boards over USB: files, Python, firmware install, ctrlPi API install.

plugins.name: pi-bay
plugins.description: Work with Raspberry Pis and other SSH devices on your LAN: find them, edit files over SFTP, run commands, install the ctrlPi API.

plugins.name: ctrlpi-mcp-remote
plugins.description: Control GPIO agents through a ctrlpi-mcp running on a Raspberry Pi on your LAN: pins, relays, sensors, scripts. Use this or ctrlpi-mcp, not both.

plugins.name: pico-bay-remote
plugins.description: Work with the Pico and ESP32 boards plugged into a Raspberry Pi on your LAN, through pico-bay running there: files, Python, firmware, ctrlPi API.

plugins.name: pi-bay-remote
plugins.description: Work with Raspberry Pis and SSH devices through a pi-bay running on a Raspberry Pi on your LAN: files, commands, ctrlPi API. Use this or pi-bay, not both.
